title: twinconj: local constants of twin-prime propagation
description:
Python package, proofs, and computational data for refined, quantitative versions of Dacomb Bierton's twin-prime conjectures, together with a paper draft on the local constants of the twin-prime propagation map.

The package machine-checks the finite lemmas, computes the explicit local ratio R(g) and the mean-value constant κ = 2·C₂·R̄ = 14.76768…, and reproduces the exhaustive experiments to p ≤ 1010 (propagation actual/predicted = 1.0044). The accompanying paper proves an explicit finite-product formula for R(g) with sharp bounds 2.0836 < R(g) ≪ (log log g)², the mean values of the four- and six-form singular series, the Selberg upper bound N(X) ≪ X/(log X)³, and the identities that bi-twin chains share the singular series of prime quadruplets and S₆(6) = 3·S(sextuplet).
